claim: The full-year 2023 results: Nvidia had net income at $4.4 billion and revenue at $27.0 billion.
summary: For NVIDIA's fiscal year 2023 (year ended Jan 29, 2023, commonly referred to as full-year 2023), reported revenue was ~$26.97B (~$27.0B rounded) and GAAP net income was ~$4.37B (~$4.4B rounded), matching both stated figures within rounding.

sub_claims.text: Nvidia had full-year 2023 revenue of $27.0 billion
sub_claims.note: NVIDIA FY2023 (ended Jan 2023, reported as full-year 2023) revenue was $26.974B, which rounds to $27.0B. No tools available to cite, but consistent with model knowledge.

sub_claims.text: Nvidia had full-year 2023 net income of $4.4 billion
sub_claims.note: NVIDIA FY2023 GAAP net income was $4.368B, which rounds to $4.4B. No tools available to cite, but consistent with model knowledge.
